title: Items & Artefacts
description: Story-relevant objects, artefacts, and other nonhuman holdings that are not weapons or Holumns.

items.name: Lynleit's protective gloves
items.summary: Special black leather gloves protect Lynleit's skin during outbursts of her blue flame. She keeps them draped over her belt, usually hidden beneath her coat.

forms.name: Pair of black leather gloves
forms.detail: Carried together over the belt and pulled on before a blue-flame outburst.

properties.name: Skin protection
properties.detail: The gloves protect the skin they cover from Lynleit's blue flame. She relies on them rather than accepting burns as a normal cost of competent use.

properties.name: Practical preparation
properties.detail: She checks the gloves and cuffs before using the flame. A nearby person still needs separate coverage.

limits: Unprotected or carelessly exposed skin risks damage and scarring.
The gloves do not remove the strain of using blue flame or protect an uncovered bystander.
Their maker, construction, acquisition and limits against other forces are unknown.

chronology.phase: Early Arc 1, while Fionn is alive
chronology.title: The office-building rescue
chronology.detail: Lynleit uses the gloves while sheltering an office worker beneath her coat. Her hands remain unburned, though the exertion leaves bleeding and tremors.

items.name: Leviathan-hide coat
items.summary: A blue garment left to Lynleit through Fionn's concealed intervention. It changes form without accepting commands and shields only what Lynleit deliberately covers with it.

associatedCharacter.name: Fionn
associatedCharacter.relation: Arranged the substitution before his death

items.material: A material called the hide of leviathan
items.materialNote: The nature and source of the material are not identified.

forms.name: Blue coat
forms.detail: Its familiar full-length form and the appearance in which Lynleit first understands what Fionn left her.

forms.name: Scarf
forms.detail: A smaller form chosen by the garment without instruction from Lynleit.

forms.name: Blue suede jacket
forms.detail: The garment can imitate the fitted jacket Lynleit lost during the Drowned Choir attack.

forms.name: Other clothing
forms.detail: The coat can assume other wearable forms. Lynleit cannot choose which form appears on a given day.

properties.name: Minor magical protection
properties.detail: The material can shield a covered body from minor magically induced damage and phenomena.

properties.name: Protection by coverage
properties.detail: Wearing the garment is not sufficient. Lynleit must use it to cover the threatened part of her body.

properties.name: Protection of another person
properties.detail: Lynleit can remove the garment and place or throw it over someone who needs immediate protection.

properties.name: Autonomous form
properties.detail: The garment decides its own appearance and movement. Lynleit cannot command it; it can choose to cooperate with her, as it does while covering the office-building witness.

limits: Protection is local to the area physically covered by the garment.
The garment does not provide passive protection merely because Lynleit is wearing it.
Lynleit cannot command its form or rely on it to assume the form most useful to the situation.
How much magical force the coat can withstand is unknown.

chronology.phase: Early Arc 1, before the river revelation
chronology.title: Quiet cooperation
chronology.detail: Lynleit throws the coat over a witness before a blue-flame outburst. Its edges settle around him of their own accord. He notices something he cannot explain; Lynleit still does not know the garment's nature. The rescue occurs early in Arc 1, while Fionn is alive and before Kyrien's river revelation.

chronology.title: The lost jacket
chronology.detail: The Drowned Choir tears away Lynleit's fitted blue suede jacket while dragging her underwater. She later complains about losing it because she liked it.

chronology.title: Fionn's concealed substitution
chronology.detail: After Fionn's death, Lynleit discovers that he had discreetly replaced the blue coat she wore with the leviathan-hide garment.

chronology.title: An inherited protection
chronology.detail: Lynleit carries the garment after discovering its properties. It sometimes takes the form of the suede jacket she lost.

items.name: Kyrien's whiskey flask
items.summary: A small flask of whiskey that Kyrien keeps for difficult moments rather than routine drinking.

forms.name: Small personal flask
forms.detail: Kept in a consistent pocket; Lynleit learns where to find it.

properties.name: Measured use
properties.detail: Kyrien takes a small drink before or after exceptional danger, distress, exhaustion, cold field conditions, or a difficult personal decision.

properties.name: Private pause
properties.detail: He opens it, drinks, closes it, and carries on. He occasionally calls the whiskey medicine.

limits: The whiskey is a personal comfort, not medical treatment or a source of combat ability.
Kyrien does not drink continually during ordinary work or conversation.

chronology.title: Origin
chronology.detail: The precise source of the flask and the beginning of the habit are not known.

chronology.title: A familiar ritual
chronology.detail: Kyrien carries it through difficult work, and Lynleit becomes familiar with it.

chronology.title: The park request
chronology.detail: After they leave the bench, Lynleit unexpectedly asks for the whiskey. Kyrien gives it to her without pressing for an explanation.
